description: FastAPI router module for managing notes and tags, including CRUD operations, search, filtering, and pagination.

methods.name: _normalize_tag_name
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a tag name.

methods.name: _sort_clause
methods.description: Returns SQLAlchemy order clause based on sort field and order.

methods.name: _get_or_create_tags
methods.description: Fetches existing tags or creates new ones, ensuring case-insensitive uniqueness.

methods.name: create_note
methods.description: Creates a new note with optional tags.

methods.name: get_note
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, including tags.

methods.name: update_note
methods.description: Updates note's title, content, and tags.

methods.name: list_notes
methods.description: Lists notes with optional search, filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: list_tags
methods.description: Lists all tags sorted by name.

methods.name: create_tag
methods.description: Creates a new tag if it doesn't exist.
